title: release-engineering-meeting-notes-2026-10-27
content:
Date: 2026-10-27
Attendees: Sofia Patel (RE Manager), Mark Chen (SRE), Priya Singh (Build & Release), Luis Fernandez (Platform), Jenna Brooks (QA), Aaron Li (Customer Support)

Objective:
- Weekly release engineering sync focused on R2026.10 release train status, recent hotfix applied to production, outstanding change-log items, and rollout/rollback plans for next week.

1) Release train status (R2026.10)
- Current RC: R2026.10-rc3. Candidate freeze scheduled for 2026-10-28 18:00 PT. Canonical release window: 2026-10-29 02:00-04:00 PT (low-traffic).
- QA summary: 85% automated pass, 12 manual test failures flagged (mostly minor UI/metrics dashboards). Jenna to triage items by EOD 2026-10-27.
- Blockers: One failing end-to-end checkout flow in staging related to token refresh and KV cache invalidation (ticket RELENG-1223). Mark & Priya pairing to investigate.

2) Hotfix recap (R2026.10.1)
- Incident: Production error spikes on 2026-10-25 11:40 PT - elevated 5xx for serving-runtime when sequence length > 6k. Root cause: kernel selection fallback regression introduced in runtime PR #464.
- Action taken: Hotfix branch created and promoted to prod (release tag r2026.10.1) on 2026-10-26 03:20 PT. Deployed via rolling canary across us-west-2 -> us-east-1 -> eu-west-1.
- Outcome: Error rate returned to baseline within 12 minutes after full rollout. No customer-facing downtime; a small subset of requests were throttled during canary window.
- Post-deploy tasks: Postmortem ticket opened (INCIDENT-987). Priya to add detailed timeline and mitigation steps by 2026-10-29.

3) Change-log and release notes
- Need concise bullets for: hotfix r2026.10.1 (kernel fallback fix), model-serving default batcher change, updated docker image tag for dedicated pools, and security update for KMS integration.
- Action: Sofia to draft release notes intro. Luis to provide exact docker/image tags and checksum (due 2026-10-28 12:00 PT). Jenna to confirm QA-approved phrasing for known issues section.

4) Rollout strategy and canary policy updates
- Proposed change: shorten canary step from 30m -> 15m for non-breaking runtime patches if automated health-checks pass at t+5m and t+10m. Rationale: reduce blast radius time and speed mean-time-to-fix.
- Concern: shorter canary may miss intermittent failures seen in long-tail traffic. Mark requested a trial on one non-customer-facing service first.
- Decision: approve A/B trial on metrics-exporter pipeline for R2026.11. Priya to implement config change in deployments repo (PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deployments/pull/309).

5) Rollback and mitigation playbooks
- Confirmed rollback procedure for runtime: tag-to-image mapping in artifact registry, immediate route-to-previous via traffic manager, and ephemeral cache flush.
- New step: automated post-rollback verification script (sre/ops/verify_rollback.sh) to run smoke tests + key metric checks. Aaron to add customer communication template to playbook.

6) Cross-team notes and dependencies
- Customer Support reported two escalations linked to hotfix timing; both resolved. Aaron will sync with affected accounts and include summary in customer-facing notes.
- Product requested an explicit line in release notes re: embeddings endpoint behavior change; product PM to approve wording by 2026-10-28.

7) Artifacts and images
- Artifacts to land for canonical release: runtime:v2026.10.0-rc3, runtime-hotfix:v2026.10.1, serving-proxy:v1.14.0, deployments images with digest info (Luis to provide).

8) Metrics & SLOs to watch during rollout
- 5xx rate (global), p99 latency for text-generation, KV cache hit-rate, GPU utilization on dedicated pools. Dashboards: /dashboards/release/R2026.10 (Mark to ensure chart ownership).

9) Action items (owner - due)
- Priya Singh - deep analysis and timeline for INCIDENT-987 postmortem (due 2026-10-29).
- Mark Chen & Priya Singh - fix failing e2e checkout flow in staging (RELENG-1223) and update CI gating rules (due 2026-10-28).
- Luis Fernandez - publish docker image tags + checksums and confirm dedicated pool impact (due 2026-10-28 12:00 PT).
- Jenna Brooks - triage 12 manual QA failures and confirm which must block RC (due 2026-10-27 EOD).
- Aaron Li - prepare customer communication template referencing hotfix and CJ notes (due 2026-10-28).
- Sofia Patel - draft release notes and change-log bullets (due 2026-10-28 10:00 PT).

10) Risks & mitigations
- Risk: Late discovery of regression after shorter canary. Mitigation: require automated long-tail synthetic traffic test during canary in addition to real traffic; revert config only after 1h of stable long-tail test for critical services.
- Risk: Image checksum mismatch leading to accidental rollback of wrong artifact. Mitigation: strict digest verification step in deployment pipeline.

Next meeting:
- Weekly release sync: 2026-11-03 09:00 PT. Special pre-release check-in: 2026-10-28 16:00 PT (final go/no-go for canonical release).

Notes & references:
- See RELENG-1223 for staging e2e failure details.
- Postmortem: INCIDENT-987 (link in linked_artifacts).
- PRs: runtime fix PR #482, deployments config PR #309.

Minutes recorded by: Sofia Patel
